findings.description: A large gold coin sitting right at the rim of the center cup from 00:00 to 00:02 vanishes or sinks out of sight by 00:03 without anyone touching that cup.

findings.entity: coin in right hand and leftmost cup
findings.description: As the man lowers the gold coin with his right hand, the coin clips through the rim and becomes plastered flat against the outside wall of the leftmost cup from 00:04 to 00:06.

Four cups are lined up on the table at 00:05-00:06, but at 00:07 the rightmost cup vanishes completely as the man's left hand moves down to the table, leaving only three cups for the remainder of the shot.
